images.title: Equal heights, same length
images.purpose: Show that a thread with both ends equally high stays flat and has the same length as the base AB.
images.composition: One rectangle centred with three flat amber threads stacked evenly, and one bracket for the base length.
images.exact_structure: One rectangle ABCD, outline teal #0072B2, AB bottom 7 cm and BC 4 cm. Three flat amber #E69F00 threads from left side to right side at heights 5 mm, 1 cm and 1 cm 5 mm, all parallel to AB and each as long as AB. A grey #6B7280 bracket under AB labelled 7 cm. Exactly 1 rectangle, 3 threads, 1 bracket.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
tilted threads, or threads of different lengths
images.takeaway: When both ends are equally high, the thread stays flat and equals AB.
images.description: Rectangle ABCD with three flat parallel threads at different heights, all as long as the 7 cm base AB.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to slide a finger up the threads and say what stays the same.

image_decisions.why: One clean geometry picture carries the single idea of this video.
